assign.title: AI index: a day stream of task and session changes
assign.outcome:
**Every task or session change now appends one line to that day's `index.jsonl`, and the dashboard patches the changed row from it.**

- [x] one stream line per change, per day folder: `sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/index.jsonl`, written by the new class [AIIndexStream](/Server/AIIndexStream.mjs) from `AIIndex` (tasks) and `AISessionIndex` (sessions). Proof: `node Server/AIIndex.test.mjs` passes, including one line on a landing and none on an unchanged re-read.
- [x] the browser tails today's stream and patches rows: `rail/DayIndexLog.js` + `DashState.patch()`; the 2.4 MB `ai/index.json` is now refetched at most once per 5 s (was every change).
- [x] one indexing system, named: three files, three jobs (day `index.json` = session snapshots, day `index.jsonl` = change stream, `ai/index.json` = task picture), written down in [ai-index.md](/Server/doc/ai-index.md) and the [ai readme](/framework/ai/readme.md) On disk table.
- [ ] `ai/index.json` rebuilt from the streams, open items only: not done. It stays a fold of the logs (a stream missing one line would silently lose a task); the stream is a fast path in front of it.
- [ ] month/year rollups of the stream: not added; `AISessionIndex.roll` still rolls the closed day files.

Live after `node Servex/sustain.mjs --restart` (the AIIndex watcher is Server code). Review: none (self-evident, small additive diff).
